description: This file declares functions and constants related to the ConfUI protocol used within the Cuttlefish project. It includes message handling, sending commands, and parsing UI messages for the ConfUI system.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiMessage object to its string representation.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a ConfUiMessage from a file descriptor, optionally associated with a session ID.

methods.name: SendAbortCmd
methods.description: Sends an abort command for a session over the provided file descriptor.

methods.name: SendAck
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment or response message over the provided file descriptor.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response containing user selection and optional signed message.

methods.name: SendStartCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to start the ConfUI session with prompt and options.

methods.name: SendStopCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to stop the ConfUI session.

methods.name: SendUserSelection
methods.description: Sends user selection or cancelation event.
